description:
Construction of a replacement single storey
rear extension and conversion of garage into habitable space including
replacement of garage door with two windows. Construction of outbuilding in
rear garden. Alterations to soft and hard landscaping, installation of 2 new
rooflights, alterations to fenestrations and door replacement (Amended Description)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development:</p><p><span style="font-size:14pt">Location plan</span></p><p><span style="font-size:14pt">KNA, 17 College Place/KN/01.02.2024 Heritage Statement </span></p><p><span style="font-size:14pt">COLLEGE PLACE PLANNING DESIGN REPORT KNA 25.01.2024</span></p><p><span style="font-size:14pt">01, 02,03,04,05,06,07, 08,09,10,11,12,13,14,16, 21,22,23,24,25,26,29,30.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

Prior to the commencement of the development, detailed drawings and samples of all materials to be used for the boundary treatments of the building,&nbsp; any materials for the hard landscaping within the front garden, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out solely in accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained as such.
The roof area of the development hereby approved shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or sitting out area at any time.
